title: Lean (new release!)
features:
Configurable Silent Aim, Triggerbot, Ragebot (Wall Check, Team Check, Hitscan, Distance, FOV) Keybinds between toggle Hold and Always.

Visuals : Box, Skeleton, Chams, with Chams being able to be configured for non-visible color and visible color with transparency and more. 3D Preview!

All kind of gun mods, Fly, Vehicle Fly with noclip and more.
